L63: ##
L64: 
L65: Artifact Overview
L66: 
L67: The Ford Model T used a two-speed planetary gearset in its transmission throughout the car's production run from 1908-1927. The central sun gear was surrounded by planet gears that rotated around it. Because the gears were always in mesh, they were easier to shift than the unsynchronized sliding gearsets of the time.
